title: Darkbloom switch cost: recovery curve over 59 recorded slots, one M4 Max (EXPLORATORY, pinned)

statement.criteria: EXPLORATORY, retrospective: rules declared in docs/CAMPAIGN-2026-09-27.md section 2 before the analysis was run, but the slot archive already existed, so this is NOT pre-registered and carries no prereg link. analysis/switch_cost.py pinned --until 2026-09-27T23:52:00Z so it is re-derivable — the earlier unpinned snapshot ds-6f9252fe was not. 59 non-dry recorded slots from 8 campaigns; Apple M4 Max 64GB 40-core, macOS 27.0, Darkbloom 0.9.9-0.9.10. Revenue divided only by exposure observed inside a slot window; base_reward excluded. The cold-vs-resident split is POST-HOC. Supersedes ds-6f9252fe: same method, 12 more switches, and the resident-switch figure there (1.54x at n=5) was small-n noise — it is 0.96x at n=8.
